categories.main_business_segments: Jouder Precision Industry (Kunshan) Co., Ltd. primarily operates in precision mold and components manufacturing, focusing on automotive mold components, semiconductor and computer mold components, home appliance mold components, automation equipment parts, and medical device precision components. The company serves specialized equipment manufacturing and general equipment manufacturing sectors, with a strong emphasis on automotive molds and automation equipment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced manufacturing processes including precision machining, intelligent equipment systems, and digitalized production management platforms. It emphasizes R&D in high-precision mold parts, automation components such as gear racks and linear guides, and medical device components, employing technologies like five-axis milling, automated marking, and modular design to enhance product quality and production efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major automotive manufacturers and mold suppliers such as SAIC Volkswagen, Beijing Benz, Shenyang BMW, FAW Toyota, and leading new energy vehicle companies like BYD, Xiaomi, Li Auto, and NIO. The company also serves industries in semiconductor equipment, home appliances, industrial automation, and medical devices, including surgical robotics and orthopedic instruments.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Kunshan and regional manufacturing centers in Dongguan, Tianjin, Wuhan, and Chongqing. It has a nationwide sales and service network covering major industrial regions in China and actively expands its international market presence through overseas distributors and participation in global exhibitions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jouder Precision functions mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the design, development, and manufacturing of precision mold components and automation parts. It procures raw materials such as mold steels and components from upstream suppliers and delivers finished precision parts to downstream automotive OEMs, mold makers, and equipment manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technology-driven growth with strategic R&D investments in precision mold parts, automation equipment, and medical device components. It focuses on product diversification into new energy vehicles, semiconductor, and medical sectors, enhancing intelligent manufacturing, digital transformation, and cost control. R&D efforts include developing high-precision gears, compact wedge assemblies, automated marking systems, and medical surgical tools, supported by a strong patent portfolio and talent development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of precision mold components, automation equipment parts, and medical device components. The company employs a dual sales channel model with direct sales to end customers and indirect sales via distributors, serving both domestic and international markets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jouder Precision is positioned as a leading domestic supplier in the precision mold components industry with a strong foothold in automotive molds. It competes with other specialized mold and precision parts manufacturers in China and internationally, leveraging its technological innovation, quality control, and comprehensive service capabilities to maintain industry leadership.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 347 million, a slight increase of 1.56% year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 13.7 million, down 20.97%. The company maintains stable asset growth and continues investing in R&D (~5.3% of revenue). Despite profit pressure from industry cycles and cost factors, it sustains a solid financial scale with ongoing strategic investments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jouder Precision emphasizes precision, speed, and innovation, offering customized, high-quality precision mold components and automation parts with strong technical barriers. Its value proposition includes comprehensive lifecycle services, rapid response capabilities, and integration with leading automotive and industrial customers. The company differentiates through advanced manufacturing technologies, a robust patent portfolio, and a global marketing and service network.
